# Alpha 41 — shared mobile and storage components

- Consolidate system document pickers, scoped file access, native menus, text Find/Replace, memory notifications and Android event-loop handling in commonUtils.
- Share verified file snapshots, archive member rebuilding and directory relocation while keeping document, credential and migration policy in Logistics.
- Preserve existing Android key identities, iOS Keychain identities, private-copy formats and EPUB container rules.
- Preserve Windows file verification when pathname and descriptor timestamps use different meanings.
- Capture complete native windows in mobile evidence, avoiding zero-sized content during navigation reparenting.
- Harden shutdown against queued native callbacks and reject overlapping relocation paths before copying.

File-object copy behavior is unchanged. This remains an alpha release; mobile artifacts are development builds rather than signed store releases.
